- Choose whether landscape videos follow the sensor or keep the top of the phone on the left or right, while portrait videos stay upright
- Switch the previous Portrait setting to Video Orientation on upgrade
- Enable playback notifications on Android 13 and later from the player, or open notification settings when starting background playback

---

- 支持按视频方向播放时固定手机顶部朝左或朝右，也可继续跟随传感器，竖屏视频仍按竖屏播放
- 将旧版固定为「纵向」的设置自动切换为「视频方向」
- 支持在 Android 13 及以上版本首次进入播放器时开启通知，后台播放时若通知已关闭，可直接前往系统设置开启
